title: Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Crowd Flow Control Using Dynamic Barriers
abstract: arXiv:2610.34163v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Crowd barriers are widely used to regulate pedestrian movement during large public events such as pilgrimages. However, fixed barrier layouts often create unnecessary stopping and local congestion even when they successfully control the overall crowd flow. Finding better barrier configurations is difficult because there is no dataset that provides the best barrier placement for a given crowd scene. We address this challenge by introducing a simulation-driven reinforcement learning framework that learns barrier configurations without requiring labelled training data. Starting from a segmented crowd scene, we construct a realistic simulation environment that reproduces the observed pedestrian distribution. This environment is then used to train a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent that continuously adjusts barrier positions to improve pedestrian movement. translated_title: 基于动态屏障的自适应人流控制强化学习
translated_abstract: 人群屏障被广泛用于在朝圣等大型公共活动期间调节行人的移动。然而，固定的屏障布局即使成功控制了整体人群流动，也常常造成不必要的停顿和局部拥堵。寻找更优的屏障配置十分困难，因为目前没有任何数据集能提供针对给定人群场景的最佳屏障布置方案。我们通过引入一个由仿真驱动的强化学习框架来应对这一挑战，该框架无需标注训练数据即可学习屏障配置。从一个分割的人群场景出发，我们构建了一个逼真的仿真环境，能够再现观测到的行人分布。随后利用该环境训练一个Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）智能体，使其持续调整屏障位置以改善行人的移动状况。与监督式方法不同，所提出的框架允许智能体探索屏障……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需标注数据的仿真驱动强化学习框架，通过训练SAC智能体动态调整屏障位置，实现自适应的人群流动控制，从而减少不必要的停顿和局部拥堵。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a simulation-driven reinforcement learning framework requiring no labelled data, which trains a Soft Actor-Critic agent to dynamically adjust barrier positions for adaptive crowd flow control, reducing unnecessary stopping and local congestion.
